lastResponse.text: I’m with you, and I hear how overwhelmed you are. Your audio is breaking up, so I may miss words. If he still won’t wake up or breathing is strange, call nine one one now. To keep this simple, say just one word: “nine one one” if it’s still an emergency, or “detox” if he’s awake and you want treatment options next.
originalTexts: I’m with you, and I hear how overwhelmed you are. Your audio is breaking up, so I may miss words. If he still won’t wake up or breathing is strange, call 911 now. To keep this simple, say just one word: **“911”** if it’s still an emergency, or **“detox”** if he’s awake and you want treatment options next.
